ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black; the fluke surface is composed primarily of mid-tone grey (65%) and deep black (35%) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central black contiguous region extending from the peduncle to the notch; mottled grey-scale pixel distribution across lateral lobes; high-contrast dark linear banding at the distal tips (X: 10-50, 950-990).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 155 degrees and shallow pixel-depth relative to horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge profile with low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; minor pixel-depth valleys observed primarily on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to slight concavity towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of dark circular pixel clusters (potential scarring) localized on the inner-mid regions of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the distal ventral tips of both lobes, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct parallel rake marks on the distal extremities of both fluke lobes; minor irregular truncation on the far right trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark pigmentation concentrated at the central axis/peduncle insertion point, forming a tapering wedge shape towards the notch.
